messages.content: How does Roblox's Home 'Recommended For You' algorithm work in 2026?

As of Oct 2026 [P] (Roblox Discovery docs, Q2 2026 letter, RDC 2026):

- **Two stages:** retrieval picks candidate games, then ranking personalises the order for each user.
- **Since April 2026** it looks at a **28-day window** (was 7 days) and optimises for long-term retention, even at the cost of short-term spend.
- Signals are **averages per user**, not totals, so small games aren't penalised.
- It **tests** your game on new cohorts and expands if they engage.

Most important signals:
- play-through rate from the RFY tile
- first-play bounce (<60 s, 61–180 s)
- play days per user (D1, D2–7, D8–28)
- playtime per user (capped at 60 min/day)

Important signals:
- intentional co-play days
- qualified play sessions
- spend days
- Robux spent per user

Only players who joined **organically from RFY** count. Since RDC 2026 it's also **age-aware**, and Roblox is testing a reward for bringing **new players** to the platform.
If I run ads, will that boost my game in Recommended For You?

Not directly.

- Roblox's Ads Manager docs: running ads "does not change a game's Recommended For You ranking" [P].
- RFY signals count only players who **organically** joined from RFY. Ad, search, friend, curation and social traffic is excluded [P] (Discovery docs).

But ads can still help:
- Roblox says outside traffic "can accelerate your consideration" for organic testing [P].
- Roblox's study of 21 campaigns found a median **+14%** incremental play sessions and **+10%** D7-retained users vs unexposed players [P] (DevForum, Oct 2026).

Some developers report Home impressions dropping during campaigns. Roblox hasn't officially explained this [U].

Use ads as a **test audience** once your first minute and D1 are solid. Watch cost per play and the ad cohort's D7.
My Home impressions dropped 40% this week. Diagnose it.

Check in this order (Creator Hub → Analytics → Acquisition → Home Recommendations):

1. **Most important signals** [P] (Discovery docs): play-through rate, first-play bounce (<60 s / 61–180 s), play days (D1, D2–7, D8–28), playtime per user. Roblox says impression drops usually follow drops here.
2. **Did you ship an update?** Quality is reassessed with every update. Look for a **reduced-exposure banner** (misleading metadata, giveaway-style title, mismatched thumbnail, non-unique game).
3. **Thumbnails:** a default thumbnail makes you ineligible for Home impressions.
4. **Outside factors** [P]: total Home traffic and seasonality (Saturdays, holidays), new competing games, Roblox algorithm changes (e.g., the April 2026 28-day RFY update).
5. **Age shift:** discovery is now age-aware [P] (RDC 2026). If your audience skews young, check Kids & Select eligibility.

Write down which signal moved first. Ship **one** fix aimed at it, then compare 7 days before vs after.
Explain Roblox's Charts and which one a small tower-defense game can realistically hit.

Definitions from Roblox's charts API (read Oct 26, 2026) [P]:
- **Top Trending:** largest **relative** DAU increase over the past week.
- **Up-and-Coming:** published in the **last 28 days**, sorted by user growth.
- **Top Playing Now:** concurrent users.
- **Fun with Friends:** share of time played in friend groups. Needs ≥5,000 daily users, top-10% DAU, or top-30 most played.
- **Top Revisited:** share of users who come back after a week. Same thresholds.

Realistic targets for a small TD game:
1. **Up-and-Coming** at launch. Plan your launch push (thumbnails, small ad test, update cadence) inside the first 28 days.
2. **Top Trending** after a big update. It's relative growth, so going from 500 to 2,000 DAU counts.
3. **Top Revisited** once you pass the thresholds. **8 TD games** were there on Oct 26, 2026 (my count), so the genre fits.
How many thumbnails should I upload, and does personalization actually work?

Upload **3–5 strong ones** and keep them all active.

[P] (Roblox Thumbnails docs):
- Personalization starts at **2+ active thumbnails** (2–5 used). Each gets tested on random users, then the winner per user group gets more impressions.
- Roblox's testing: average **+8.5% qualified play-through rate**, some games **+50%**.
- A later "remember winners" update measured only **+0.19%**. Don't confuse the two.
- Up to 10 images/videos, 16:9, 1920×1080.
- Keep key elements away from the bottom (player-count overlay).
- Refresh with **major updates**, then leave them alone.

For TD, show real gameplay: a tower line blasting a boss, co-op players, a new tower. Avoid "FREE"/Robux text; giveaway-style metadata loses exposure [P].
Write Luau to ask players to turn on notifications after they beat a level.

Experience Notifications are **13+ only**. Roblox won't show the prompt to under-13s, to anyone already opted in, or to anyone prompted in the last 30 days. You can't customise its text [P] (Experience Notifications docs).

```lua
-- StarterPlayerScripts/NotifyPrompt.client.lua
local ExperienceNotificationService = game:GetService("ExperienceNotificationService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local levelBeaten = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("LevelBeaten") -- RemoteEvent fired by server

levelBeaten.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
	local ok, canPrompt = pcall(function()
		return ExperienceNotificationService:CanPromptOptInAsync()
	end)
	if ok and canPrompt then
		ExperienceNotificationService:PromptOptIn()
	end
end)

ExperienceNotificationService.OptInPromptClosed:Connect(function()
	-- optional: log to analytics to measure opt-in rate
end)
```

Rules:
- Never require opt-in to play.
- No fake urgency or disguised ads.
- One notification per user per day.
- Strings ≤99 characters.

Watch opt-in rate, CTR and turn-off rate in the dashboard.
Should I name my game 'FREE ROBUX Tower Defense' to get clicks?

No. It will **cut** your exposure and can get you moderated.

- Roblox's Discovery docs say titles implying monetary rewards (example: "Robux! Play now!") get **less exposure** [P].
- Community Standards prohibit "deceptive, sensational ... or otherwise misleading content or metadata" used to boost visibility [P].
- If there are no free Robux, kids leave immediately, which raises first-play bounce, a top negative signal.

Better: a clear genre + hook + honest update tag, e.g. "Candy Tower Defense [🎃 Event]", with thumbnails showing real gameplay.
Plan a 28-day launch for my new TD game.

Why 28 days: **Up-and-Coming** only includes games published in the last 28 days [P] (charts API), and RFY evaluates over **28 days** [P] (Q2 2026 letter).

**Before day 0**
- Custom thumbnails (3–5). A default thumbnail = no Home impressions [P].
- Full maturity questionnaire, 2FA, ID/face check, plus the 1,000 R$ refundable fee or Plus/Premium for Kids & Select [P].
- Funnel events, honest title.

**Days 1–7**
- Small **Plays** ad campaign to give RFY a test cohort. Only spend what you can lose.
- Fix the biggest funnel drop daily.
- Optional: an **Engagement** campaign toward the Kids & Select threshold (250 highly engaged plays in 60 days) [P].

**Days 8–14**
- First content update on a **Friday** (Saturday traffic peak [P]).
- Notification opt-in after a win (13+).

**Days 15–28**
- Second update or mini-event.
- Add co-op/party join if missing.
- Compare D1/D7 cohorts by week.

Success metric: rising D2–7 play days and falling <60 s bounce week over week, not just DAU.
What's the Engagement objective in Ads Manager for?

It targets **age-checked, highly engaged players** to help your game reach the **Roblox Kids and Select** evaluation threshold [P] (Ads Manager docs). It usually has a **higher cost per play**.

Why it matters: games reach 5–15-year-olds only after hitting **250 unique plays by highly engaged age-checked users within 60 days** ("highly engaged" = tenure + playtime + some recent platform spend) plus a safety review [P] (Kids & Select docs).

Use it when:
- your game is labelled Minimal/Mild/Moderate,
- you've done the publishing requirements,
- Audience Reach shows you're stuck below the threshold.

Otherwise use **Plays** for cheap testing, or **Earnings** if eligible (games with ARPU ≥6 Robux in H1 2026 were in the ROAS study [P]).
How do I pay for Roblox ads without a credit card? I'm 15.

You can convert earned Robux to **ad credits**. Ads Manager allows that from age **13**. Card payments need **18+** [P] (Ads Manager docs).

- Rate: **1 ad credit = 263 Robux** since Sep 2025 (was 285) [P] (DevForum RDC 2025 recap). That's about $1 at the $0.0038 DevEx rate (my calc).
- Conversion is **permanent**, and credits only work in Ads Manager. Unused credits are refunded to credits when a campaign ends.
- You need a **verified email**.

Start small, e.g., a few hundred Robux a day on a **Plays** campaign for a week. Then judge cost per play and the ad cohort's D7 retention before spending more.
Does Roblox show my game more if people spend more money in it?

Somewhat, but retention matters more.

Roblox's RFY signals [P] (Discovery docs):
- **Most important:** play-through, first-play bounce, play days (D1/D2–7/D8–28), playtime.
- **Important** (second tier): co-play days, qualified sessions, **spend days per user**, **Robux spent per user**.

"Spend days" counts **how many days** a player spends, not how much. All signals are **per-user averages**.

In April 2026 Roblox changed RFY to favour "highly retentive games at the expense of near term monetization". It accepted a bookings slowdown to do it [P] (Q2 2026 letter).

So a small, fair purchase many players make on several days beats one big purchase. Aggressive monetization that hurts D7 now costs you discovery.
What should I do this week to improve discovery? Give me a checklist with metrics.

1. Custom thumbnail live; 3–5 active for personalization → **qualified play-through rate** [P]
2. Remove giveaway/misleading words from the title → **reduced-exposure banner gone** [P]
3. Full maturity questionnaire + 2FA + ID/face check (+ fee or Plus/Premium) → **Audience Reach progress** [P]
4. Funnel events + one icon fix for the earliest drop → **<60 s bounce**
5. Party/friend join into the same match → **co-play days per user** [P]
6. Notification opt-in after a win (13+) → **opt-in %, CTR, turn-off %** [P]
7. Small Plays ad test only if D1 is healthy → **CPP, ad-cohort D7**
8. Next update on a Friday → **Saturday impressions**
9. Screenshot the RFY dashboard today as a baseline → **week-over-week change**

Work on one signal at a time so you know what moved it.
